settings.content: Two pictures of the same pose and framing (same size, e.g. 1080 x 1080). Shoppers drag the line between them.

settings.label: Before picture (left side)
settings.info: Until a picture is picked, the frame stays empty (the editor marks the spot).

settings.label: Theme file while empty
settings.info: Path inside assets/, e.g. images/xx-sections/before.webp. Shown until a file is picked above.

settings.label: After picture (right side)
settings.info: Until a picture is picked, the frame stays empty (the editor marks the spot).

settings.label: Theme file while empty
settings.info: Path inside assets/, e.g. images/xx-sections/after.webp. Shown until a file is picked above.

settings.label: Label on the before side
settings.info: Optional, e.g. BEFORE. Empty = no label.

settings.label: Label on the after side
settings.info: Optional, e.g. AFTER. Empty = no label.

settings.label: Picture frame

options.label: Same shape as the after picture

settings.info: Square, portrait and landscape crop the pictures to fill the frame.

settings.label: Pictures side
settings.info: Computer screens. On phones the pictures sit above the text.

settings.label: Text
settings.default:
If you want your clothes to fit better and feel more supported throughout the day, Brixpant was made for you.

Built with Brixpant Compression Tank, it delivers a snug, supportive fit that smooths your silhouette and offers all-day comfort. The result: a sharper look, better posture awareness, and the kind of self-assurance that comes from feeling good in what you wear.
